name: NotificationCenter
label: Notification centre
description: A persistent notification inbox with unread count, filter tabs, and per-item actions.

props.name: title
props.description:
Heading shown in the header.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which NotificationCenter does not expose.

props.name: unreadCount
props.description: How many notifications are unread, shown under the heading. Omit to hide the line.

props.name: unreadCountLabel
props.description: Text of the unread line under the heading, given the count. Defaults to "<count> unread".

props.name: tabsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the filter tablist. Defaults to "<title> filters".

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Fires when "Mark all read" is pressed; the control only renders when this is set.

props.name: markAllLabel
props.description: Text of the mark-all-read control.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Filter tabs under the header, each with an optional count.

props.name: value
props.description:
Value of the active filter tab, for controlled use. Leave it undefined to
let the component keep its own selection, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the tab active on first render when the tabs are uncontrolled.
Falls back to the first tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected tab's value.

props.name: activeTab
props.description: Legacy name for `value`; `value` wins when both are set.

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Legacy name for `defaultValue`; `defaultValue` wins when both are set.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Legacy change callback; fires alongside `onValueChange`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: What to render when there are no children — defaults to a built-in empty state.

props.name: emptyStateLabels
props.description:
The built-in empty state's copy, merged over the English defaults: title
"Nothing new", description "Notifications will collect here as they
arrive." Ignored when `emptyState` is set.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the tab counts are written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: children
props.description: The notifications, newest first — typically NotificationItems.

props.name: title
props.description:
One-line headline, e.g. who did what.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which NotificationItem does not expose.

props.name: time
props.description: When it happened, as already-formatted text like "2m" or "Mon".

props.name: unread
props.description: Marks the notification as not yet read: a dot beside the time and emphasised title.

props.name: unreadLabel
props.description: Visually hidden text announcing the unread dot. Defaults to "Unread".

props.name: media
props.description: Leading visual — a Material Symbol name (string) or a custom element (e.g. an Avatar).

props.name: actions
props.description: Action row under the body — typically compact Buttons like "Reply" or "Retry".

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting copy under the title.

EmptyStateOwnProps.description: Props owned by EmptyState itself — everything else falls through to the root div.
